title: The JUBAP Framework
context:
## The JUBAP Framework
El marco combina el cambio de nivel de observación de UP con el filtro de acciones de JUMP. Las preguntas sobre participación, desbloqueo, movimiento observable y propagación ayudan a elegir por dónde empezar.
Etiquetas: Autoridad, permisos y delegación 15.39%; Control mínimo y suficiencia 15.39%; Decisiones y responsabilidad 23.08%; Investigación y documentación técnica 15.38%; Economía, costes y liquidez 15.38%; Cambio de perspectiva 15.38%
Ficha: https://dakleyer.github.io/perspective-beyond/constelacion/#ficha-jubap-framework
Documento de origen: https://jubap.eu/the-jubap-framework/

relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
Diagnóstico de insuficiencia frente a reconstrucción
Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
relations.reading: The Nestlé account describes how the dashboard, liberation strategy and six-domain root-cause tool were used as a sequence.

relations.title: Structural Awareness
relations.reading: The four-series programme can supply distinct diagnostic questions for reading JUBAP in the field without treating their convergence as four independent validations of the framework.

relations.title: When You Have to Decide Before You Can Discover
relations.reading: Focus ON can distinguish an observable operating obstacle from a still-unmade declaration of ownership, scope or priority that the diagnosis cannot simply discover.

relations.title: Optimization, Coherence, and the Frame
relations.reading: The UP move can expose alternatives outside a local frame, while an independently stated upstream outcome is needed to judge whether the new perspective is coherent.

relations.title: Tiger Team Compression Model
relations.reading: JUBAP's expansion-and-filtering sequence offers a practical comparison for moving from architectural optionality to a focusable engineering mission.

relations.title: The Anthropology of Tiger Team Activation
relations.reading: Leverage-point selection can focus mission activation, but neither a perspective workshop nor an activation ritual substitutes for explicit authority and closure conditions.

relations.title: Tacit Knowledge Management in Distributed Tiger Teams
relations.reading: JUBAP's propagation logic can be made operational through evidence that the receiving organization can repeat the practice and handle new exceptions after the team leaves.

relations.title: Distributed Operational Intelligence Across the Americas
relations.reading: The thin integration layers described here can be read through JUBAP as focused interventions that change a leverage point while retaining useful operating capability.

relations.title: Surviving Capability: Why the Field Celebrates What the Theory Condemns
relations.reading: The network example suggests a JUBAP leverage point in the funding and transfer rule itself: make the contributing node sustainable so the wider service can work.

relations.title: Narrativa, centro y frontera: por qué los modelos simples fallan cuando llega la implementación
relations.reading: The JUBAP sequence is more useful when each stage retains the capabilities and operating conditions required for it to work, rather than becoming a ritualized checklist.

relations.title: LA TRANSFORMACIÓN EMPRESARIAL A CORTO PLAZO ES POSIBLE.
relations.reading: The early JUMP UP account adds historical detail to the action filter behind today’s JUBAP sequence of perspective, precision and propagation.

relations.title: LA TRANSFORMACIÓN EMPRESARIAL A CORTO PLAZO ES POSIBLE.
relations.reading: For a historical explanation of the action filter, the early JUMP UP article shows why a precise intervention depends on preparation and practical entry conditions.

relations.title: Why bounded awareness may prevent mission drift without exhaustive domain knowledge
relations.reading: JUBAP’s perspective shift could motivate a test of whether recognizing a frame’s limits protects the mission more effectively than adding unrelated domain detail.

relations.title: Why bounded awareness may prevent mission drift without exhaustive domain knowledge
relations.reading: The framework’s perspective shift may motivate a later test of epistemic-limit awareness, without making its historical cases evidence that FH-C is already proven.
